description: The disjunction of the terms selecting the true rows represents every finite truth function and uses only its listed inputs.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.canonicalDnf_represents.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → α)
  (f : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TruthFunction n) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Represents p f
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.dnfFormula (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.canonicalDnf p f))
